+	// ConsistentHash configures consistent hashing for the route. When set,
+	// Envoy uses the specified hash policies to determine which upstream host
+	// receives each request, enabling session affinity.
+	// NOTE: This field is only honored for HTTPRoute targets.
+	// +optional
+	ConsistentHash *ConsistentHashPolicy `json:"consistentHash,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// ConsistentHashPolicy configures hash-based load balancing on a route.
+// Hash policies determine which upstream host receives each request based
+// on request attributes like headers, cookies, or query parameters.
+// +kubebuilder:validation:XValidation:rule="!has(self.disable) || self.disable == false || (!has(self.headers) && !has(self.cookies) && !has(self.queryParameters) && !has(self.filterState) && !has(self.sourceIp))",message="when disable is true, no other fields may be set"
+type ConsistentHashPolicy struct {
+	// Disable suppresses consistent hashing on this route, preventing
+	// hash policies inherited from broader-scoped policies from taking effect.
+	// When true, no other fields may be set.
+	// +optional
+	Disable *bool `json:"disable,omitempty"`
+
+	// Headers specifies request headers to hash on.
+	// +optional
+	Headers []HeaderHashPolicy `json:"headers,omitempty"`
+
+	// Cookies specifies request cookies to hash on.
+	// +optional
+	Cookies []CookieHashPolicy `json:"cookies,omitempty"`
+
+	// QueryParameters specifies URL query parameters to hash on.
+	// +optional
+	QueryParameters []QueryParameterHashPolicy `json:"queryParameters,omitempty"`
+
+	// FilterState specifies Envoy filter state keys to hash on.
+	// +optional
+	FilterState []FilterStateHashPolicy `json:"filterState,omitempty"`
+
+	// SourceIP configures hashing on the source IP address.
+	// +optional
+	SourceIP *SourceIPHashPolicy `json:"sourceIp,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// HeaderHashPolicy hashes on a request header value.
+type HeaderHashPolicy struct {
+	// HeaderName is the name of the request header to hash on.
+	// +required
+	HeaderName string `json:"headerName"`
+
+	// RegexRewrite optionally rewrites the header value using a regex
+	// before hashing. The pattern is matched against the header value
+	// and the substitution replaces matching portions.
+	// +optional
+	RegexRewrite *HeaderRegexRewrite `json:"regexRewrite,omitempty"`
+
+	// Terminal indicates that if this hash policy generates a hash,
+	// subsequent hash policies should not be evaluated.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// HeaderRegexRewrite specifies a regex pattern and substitution to transform
+// a header value before hashing.
+type HeaderRegexRewrite struct {
+	// Pattern is the regex pattern to match against the header value.
+	// +required
+	Pattern string `json:"pattern"`
+
+	// Substitution is the replacement string. Capture groups from the
+	// pattern can be referenced.
+	// +required
+	Substitution string `json:"substitution"`
+}
+
+// CookieHashPolicy hashes on a request cookie value.
+type CookieHashPolicy struct {
+	// Name is the name of the cookie to hash on.
+	// +required
+	Name string `json:"name"`
+
+	// TTL specifies the cookie's time-to-live. If set and the cookie is not present,
+	// Envoy generates a cookie with this TTL. A zero TTL creates a session cookie.
+	// Accepts Go duration format (e.g. "1h30m") or plain seconds (e.g. "3600").
+	// +optional
+	TTL *string `json:"ttl,omitempty"`
+
+	// Path sets the path of the generated cookie.
+	// +optional
+	Path *string `json:"path,omitempty"`
+
+	// Attributes specifies additional cookie attributes (e.g. SameSite, Secure)
+	// to set on generated cookies.
+	// +optional
+	Attributes []CookieAttribute `json:"attributes,omitempty"`
+
+	// Terminal indicates that if this hash policy generates a hash,
+	// subsequent hash policies should not be evaluated.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// CookieAttribute defines an additional attribute for a generated cookie.
+type CookieAttribute struct {
+	// Name is the attribute name (e.g. "SameSite", "Secure", "HttpOnly").
+	// +required
+	Name string `json:"name"`
+
+	// Value is the optional attribute value (e.g. "Strict" for SameSite).
+	// +optional
+	Value *string `json:"value,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// QueryParameterHashPolicy hashes on a URL query parameter value.
+type QueryParameterHashPolicy struct {
+	// Name is the name of the URL query parameter to hash on.
+	// +required
+	Name string `json:"name"`
+
+	// Terminal indicates that if this hash policy generates a hash,
+	// subsequent hash policies should not be evaluated.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// FilterStateHashPolicy hashes on an Envoy filter state object.
+type FilterStateHashPolicy struct {
+	// Key is the name of the filter state object to hash on.
+	// The object must implement the Envoy Hashable interface.
+	// +required
+	Key string `json:"key"`
+
+	// Terminal indicates that if this hash policy generates a hash,
+	// subsequent hash policies should not be evaluated.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// SourceIPHashPolicy hashes on the source (client) IP address.
+type SourceIPHashPolicy struct {
+	// Terminal indicates that if this hash policy generates a hash,
+	// subsequent hash policies should not be evaluated.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
 }
